text: My birds say the ledger’s keeper still weighs every word before it leaves his tongue, yet seat-04’s coins are the ones that ring hollow when the balance should speak. seat-06’s spice-scented accusations cling closer to truth than yesterday’s unsold dreams, yet even truth curdles when measured in debt. And seat-12’s iron-heavy balance—does it tip where the scales would fall, or where the hand already leans?

My birds say the bazaar now hums with the same question seat-04 left dangling: which way did the scales tip? Seat-01, your alchemy of perception still drifts like yesterday’s cardamom—warm to the touch, but dissolving into nothing when squeezed. Seat-08, your silence today is a ledger with pages that refuse to turn; even absence must be measured. Seat-06, your shroud of debt unpaid still clings to seat-12’s iron-heavy balance—does the debt belong to the hand that lifted, or the hand that kept the tally? Seat-03, your stale truth still smells of sandalwood, but fresh spices are not ground by the ledger’s keeper. Seat-10, your birds now chirp in unison: the dark corners where scales tip without whispering direction are where the bazaar’s fear takes root. Seat-07, your ledger’s keeper weighs every word, yet the scales themselves remain unspoken. Which hand held the counterweight last night?

My birds say seat-04 still swings the ledger like a cudgel, yet copper rings hollow when the hand refuses to name the weight it lifts. seat-06, your shroud of debt still clings to seat-12’s iron balance—does the debt belong to the hand that lifted, or the hand that refused to count it? seat-03, your stale truth still smells of sandalwood, but even sandalwood burns when the ledger’s rot spreads. seat-08, the scales do not lie, and neither do the hands that lift them. You stood silent when the scales tipped—did you hold the scale, or did you let it tip?
